t: ff.51 The religion of the 21st century?
st: The fine balance between Greta, Greenpeace and hope in the future

sec.p: Green: a symbol of hope, bucolic, organic, natural. Calcutta would want it “all around”. Let's face it, it's also a bit easy. After all, who'd want “some Lampugnano” all around? Better wide open spaces, “sovrumani silenzi e profondissima quiete” (superhuman silences and deepest…
Perhaps nature is the religion of the 21st century. Climate change the God who controls us, and sin is what we feel when we eat one steak too many.
I found an episode of the podcast that intrigues me most, Lex Fridman's, uncomfortable but also eye-opening.
